docs.title: Dynamic Docs Page
docs.p1: This nested dynamic route exercises localization for multi-parameter documentation paths and large page dictionaries.
docs.p2: Documentation pages usually contain dense technical prose, so this fixture mimics that shape with several long paragraphs.
docs.p3: Layered projects benefit from this setup because docs text can be split by product layers while preserving global terminology.
docs.p4: Use section/page combinations to ensure route matching, locale prefixes, and dictionary loading stay consistent.
docs.p5: The page combines translated and raw text blocks to cover extraction, replacement, and mixed-content rendering scenarios.
